intro: This brief introductory task directs newly arrived recruits in Northshire Valley to speak with Eagan Peltskinner, a local furrier stationed outside Northshire Abbey. With predator numbers swelling along the valley's fringes, Eagan requires capable adventurers to hunt timber wolves and gather pelts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him. That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.
If you're interested then speak with Eagan. He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's true. I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves! Are you that person?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
